name: small-model-evals
description: Evals of small local models (Ollama, promptfoo) for app tasks: tool calls, extraction, classification, reading and tagging images, speed and memory. Immutable cases and an append-only results ledger, with a static results site.

scripts.site: cd site && bun install && bun run dev
scripts.site:build: cd site && bun install && cd .. && bun scripts/build-site.ts public
scripts.site:build:all: cd site && bun install && cd .. && bun scripts/build-site.ts
scripts.site:private: cd site && bun install && cd .. && bun scripts/build-site.ts private --serve
